prompt: `npm run build && npm pack --dry-run` currently tars up src/index.ts and tsconfig.json alongside the compiled dist/ output — package.json has no `files` allowlist, so the published tarball leaks source and would ship the wrong thing entirely if someone forgot to build first. Add a `"files": ["dist"]` allowlist so only the build output ships, and a `"prepublishOnly": "npm run build"` script so a real `npm publish` always builds first.
rationale: A real 'published the wrong tarball contents' footgun, verified with the actual npm CLI's pack/publish dry-run tooling, not a simulated check.

checks.command: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --json > pack.json && grep -q '"dist/index.js"' pack.json && ! grep -q '"src/index.ts"' pack.json && ! grep -q '"tsconfig.json"' pack.json
